entities.name: Fallen Angel
entities.description: Magic comic published by ARMADA in May 1996, telling of an angel turned into a fallen angel.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord who had Xarl turn a Serra Angel into a fallen angel and created an empire.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: Wizard who turned Trine into a fallen angel and dominated Corondor for three centuries.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Serra Angel turned into a fallen angel and an unstoppable killing machine.

entities.name: Horned Halo
entities.description: Artifact used to turn the summoned Serra Angel into a fallen angel.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Continent dominated by Xarl thanks to Trine.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: Xarl's spellsquire and appointed heir who summoned Rahel, was struck blind and became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: Angel summoned by Eskil who stopped Trine.

events.summary: Mandek Ironfist has Xarl turn a summoned Serra Angel, Trine, into a fallen angel using the Horned Halo.
events.quote: The warlord Mandek Ironfist gets the wizard Xarl to turn a summoned Serra Angel into a fallen angel

events.summary: Trine becomes an unstoppable killing machine and Mandek creates an empire.
Three centuries later Xarl dominates Corondor and appoints Eskil as heir.
events.quote: He appoints his spellsquire Eskil as his heir.

events.summary: When Xarl dies Trine goes on a rampage; Eskil summons Rahel who stops her.
events.quote: Eskil summons another angel, Rahel , who stops Trine.

events.summary: Eskil is struck blind but becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: Eskil is struck blind, but becomes a planeswalker

relations.note: Xarl turned the angel at the warlord's behest.
relations.quote: The warlord Mandek Ironfist gets the wizard Xarl to turn a summoned Serra Angel

relations.note: Eskil is his spellsquire and heir.
relations.quote: He appoints his spellsquire Eskil as his heir.
Eskil summons another angel, Rahel , who stops Trine.
